Blog.title: News
Blog.metaDescription: News, product reviews and biker guides from BigBike.
Blog.listLoadFailed: Could not load the article list.
Blog.contentTop: Beyond bringing customers premium, genuine moto touring products, Bigbike also wants to share detailed information and tips for choosing protective clothing, helmets, gloves, boots and other moto touring accessories on our NEWS page. We also regularly update reputable, quality reviews and rankings of touring protective gear along with the latest market trends.
Blog.contentBottom: Through the information and articles shared, Bigbike hopes bikers will gain more useful knowledge and be able to choose the right moto touring protective gear for themselves. However, moto touring protective products are items that require buyers to weigh many aspects such as size, material and design. That is why Bigbike recommends customers visit the store directly for advice and further support on product information and services at Bigbike. We sincerely thank our customers for their trust in Bigbike!

serviceTiles.adviceBody: Our consultants are experienced bikers who listen and recommend products that match your real needs. We do more than sell gear: we share the passion and ride with you.
serviceTiles.deliveryBody: Every product is inspected carefully before delivery. Bigbike supports nationwide shipping with careful packaging so your order arrives intact and on time.
serviceTiles.priceBody: Bigbike aims to offer competitive prices and attractive promotions. We believe strong quality does not always have to come with a high price.

Home.aboutHtml: Bigbike is proud to be one of the most trusted shops for touring and motorcycle protective gear in Ho Chi Minh City, chosen by countless riders. We specialize in a wide range of motorcycle touring gear, riding accessories and genuine protective equipment from leading brands around the world.
Home.experienceDescription: At Bigbike, our motorcycle protective gear and touring accessories come in a wide variety of styles and designs at remarkably affordable prices. Our staff know the products inside out and are always ready to advise and take care of customers whenever needed.

About.tagline: Authorized motorcycle protective gear, trusted in Ho Chi Minh City since 2014
About.intro1: Bigbike was founded in 2014 — not from a business plan, but from a passionate big bike rider who couldn't find genuine protective gear at a fair price anywhere in Saigon.
About.intro2: More than 11 years later, the shop is still in the same spot — a private alley off Âu Cơ Street. No flashy shopfront. No sprawling showroom. But enough time to sit down and properly advise every customer — including the downsides of each product.
About.intro3: That's why one generation of bikers keeps recommending us to the next.
About.qualityHeading: Why bikers have trusted Bigbike for over 11 years
About.qualityBody: We don't just sell to you — Bigbike rides with you from your first trip to your longest adventure.
About.service1Body: Bigbike staff will tell you straight when a product has limitations — heavier than average, poor ventilation for Saigon's heat, or simply not suited to your usual riding routes. Getting it right the first time beats having to come back and exchange.
About.service2Title: 11 years — one generation recommends the next
About.service2Body: Since 2014, Bigbike has served thousands of bikers across Ho Chi Minh City. Many customers have come back two, three times — and brought along friends, colleagues, even their sons. That kind of loyalty can't be bought with advertising.
About.service3Title: Better prices — no flashy shopfront overhead
About.service3Body: The shop sits in a private alley off Âu Cơ Street — significantly lower rent than a street-facing location. Those savings go directly into product pricing and the time we spend advising you properly.
About.service4Title: After-sales & warranty — with you beyond the purchase
About.service4Body: The relationship doesn't end at checkout. Bigbike handles manufacturer warranty claims, offers size exchanges within 7 days, and is always available to advise when you're ready to upgrade or add to your kit for the next trip.
About.service5Body: From full-face and flip-up helmets to touring jackets, gloves, protective boots and accessories — a full range of genuine gear with verifiable authentication, delivered safely nationwide.
About.connectHeading: FIND BIGBIKE — IN PERSON OR ONLINE
About.connect1: Over 36,000 bikers follow Bigbike on Facebook. Nearly 300 reviews with 98% of customers recommending the shop. But the best number is still you walking in, trying on a helmet, and deciding for yourself.
About.connect2: Need advice before visiting? Message Mrs. Thư on Zalo — we respond during business hours.
